description: This source file defines the `Condition` class in the OpenMRS medical record system. The class models medical conditions, problems, or diagnoses associated with a patient, including properties like condition code, clinical and verification status, related patient and encounter, dates, and previous versions. It also includes methods for copying, matching, and managing condition data.
